title: GzipBudget executor
description: Fails when the gzipped initial bundle of a built web app (every script, stylesheet and modulepreload index.html references) is over budget. Angular's own budgets measure raw sizes only.

outputPath.description: The built application's output directory, holding index.html (relative to the workspace root).

index.description: The page whose scripts, stylesheets and modulepreloads make the initial bundle.

maximumError.description: Fails above this gzipped initial size, e.g. "250kB" (b, kB, MB).

maximumWarning.description: Warns above this gzipped initial size (b, kB, MB).

level.description: gzip level, 1-9 (default 6, a typical server setting).
